1. ESTABLISH – SPEED HUMP
18th Avenue, between Irving Street and Judah Street (Supervisor District 7) (Approvable by the City
Traffic Engineer) Ken Kwong, [staff email removed — see the order]

Proposal to install a second speed hump on the block due to general complaints about speeding and
cut-through traffic.

Public Comments: Received emails in support prior to public hearing. Comment in support received
during public hearing. Question raised regarding turn restriction at 19th Avenue and Irving Street.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer for implementation.

5. ESTABLISH – TRAFFIC SIGNAL
Turk Street, midblock, between Gough Street and Laguna Street (Supervisor District 5) (Approvable by
the City Traffic Engineer) Corbin Skerrit, [staff email removed — see the order]

A new traffic signal is proposed as part of the Western Addition Community Safe Streets project. The
installation will convert an existing yellow flashing beacon and include all necessary signal
infrastructure such as poles, signals, accessible pedestrian signals, and lighting.

Public Comments: Questions raised regarding overnight flashing operation, coordination with
adjacent signals, and fixed time vs. actuated control.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer for implementation.



GENERAL COMMENTS:

 • None



Whether or not the City Traffic Engineer’s decision is considered a Final SFMTA Decision is determined by
